questions.answer:
To apply for a migrant pass through the eMPS Portal:

1. Create an account or log in to your existing account
2. Click on 'Start New Application' on the dashboard
3. Select the type of pass you need (work, study, family, etc.)
4. Fill out all required personal information
5. Upload the necessary supporting documents
6. Review your application for accuracy
7. Submit your application and pay any applicable fees
8. You'll receive a confirmation number that you can use to track your application status

The documents required for your migrant pass application depend on the type of pass you're applying for. Common documents include:

- Valid passport (with at least 6 months validity)
- Passport-sized photographs (recent)
- Proof of accommodation
- Proof of financial means
- Medical certificate
- Police clearance certificate
- Employment contract (for work pass)
- Acceptance letter (for study pass)
- Marriage certificate (for family pass)

For specific requirements based on your pass type, please check the 'Requirements' section on the application form.

To check the status of your application:

1. Log in to your eMPS Portal account
2. Go to the 'My Applications' section on your dashboard
3. Find your application in the list and click on it
4. You'll see the current status of your application

Alternatively, you can use your application reference number to check the status on the public tracking page without logging in.

Typical processing times vary by pass type:
- Tourist/Visitor pass: 5-10 business days
- Work pass: 15-30 business days
- Study pass: 10-20 business days
- Family/Dependent pass: 20-40 business days

Fees for migrant pass vary depending on the type and duration:

- Tourist/Visitor pass: $50-100 USD
- Work pass: $150-300 USD
- Study pass: $100-200 USD
- Family/Dependent pass: $100-250 USD

Payments can be made online through the eMPS Portal using credit/debit cards or through approved bank transfers. All fees are non-refundable, even if your application is denied.

Please note that fees are subject to change. The exact fee will be displayed during your application process.

Processing times for migrant pass vary depending on the type of pass and current application volumes:

- Tourist/Visitor pass: 5-10 business days
- Work pass: 15-30 business days
- Study pass: 10-20 business days
- Family/Dependent pass: 20-40 business days

Please note that these are estimated timeframes. Complex cases may take longer. You can check the status of your application through your eMPS Portal account at any time.

If you're experiencing technical issues with the eMPS Portal:

1. Try refreshing the page or clearing your browser cache
2. Make sure you're using a supported browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge)
3. Check that your internet connection is stable
4. Ensure uploaded documents meet the size and format requirements (PDF, JPG, PNG under 5MB)
5. If uploading documents fails, try reducing the file size or converting to a different format

If problems persist, please contact technical support at support@emps-portal.gov with details of the issue and screenshots if possible.

If your application has been rejected:

1. Log in to your eMPS Portal account
2. Go to the rejected application
3. Review the reasons for rejection carefully
4. Click on the 'Appeal Decision' button (available for 30 days after rejection)
5. Provide additional information or documentation addressing the reasons for rejection
6. Submit your appeal

Alternatively, you may start a new application addressing the issues that led to the rejection. Appeals typically take 15-30 business days to process.

To extend or renew your existing pass:

1. Log in to your eMPS Portal account
2. Go to 'My pass' section
3. Find the pass you wish to extend and click 'Apply for Extension'
4. Complete the extension application form
5. Upload any required supporting documents
6. Pay the extension fee
7. Submit your application

Important: Apply for extensions at least 30 days before your current pass expires to avoid penalties or being required to leave the country.

To change your pass type (e.g., from tourist to work pass):

1. Log in to your eMPS Portal account
2. Go to 'My pass' section
3. Find your current pass and click 'Apply for Change of Status'
4. Select the new pass type you wish to apply for
5. Complete the application form
6. Upload all required documents for the new pass type
7. Pay the applicable fees
8. Submit your application

Note that not all pass types can be changed while in the country. Some changes may require you to apply from your home country.

To include dependents (spouse, children under 18) in your pass application:

1. When completing your main application, indicate that you have dependents to include
2. Provide the required information for each dependent
3. Upload supporting documents for each dependent (birth certificates, marriage certificates, etc.)
4. Pay the additional fees for each dependent

Alternatively, if you already have a valid pass, you can apply for dependent pass through the 'Family Applications' section of your eMPS Portal account.

Dependents typically receive pass valid for the same duration as the main applicant.

If you need help with the eMPS Portal or your application, you have several options:

1. Visit our Help Center: Access comprehensive guides and frequently asked questions at help.emps-portal.gov

2. Contact Support:
   - Email: support@emps-portal.gov
   - Phone: +255-22-123-4567 (Mon-Fri, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EAT)

3. In-Person Assistance:
   - Visit any Immigration Office during working hours
   - Schedule an appointment through the portal for personalized assistance

4. Live Chat:
   - Available on the portal during business hours

For urgent matters related to approved applications, please contact the nearest Immigration Office directly.

If you're having trouble logging into your eMPS Portal account:

1. For forgotten passwords:
   - Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page
   - Enter the email address associated with your account
   - Follow the instructions sent to your email to reset your password

2. If your account is locked:
   - Wait 30 minutes before trying again
   - If still locked, contact support with your username and the email address used for registration

3. For persistent login issues:
   - Clear your browser cache and cookies
   - Try using a different browser
   - Ensure you're using the correct email/username
   - Check that Caps Lock is not enabled when typing your password

4. If you can't remember your registered email:
   - Contact support at support@emps-portal.gov with your full name, date of birth, and passport number for verification

The eMPS Portal offers several types of migrant passes to suit different needs:

1. Work Pass: For those employed by a Tanzanian company or organization
   - Class A: For investors and self-employed individuals
   - Class B: For employees with specific skills
   - Class C: For missionaries, volunteers, and NGO workers

2. Student Pass: For those enrolled in Tanzanian educational institutions

3. Visitor/Tourist Pass: For short-term visits (tourism, family visits, etc.)

4. Business Pass: For those conducting business activities but not employed in Tanzania

5. Family/Dependent Pass: For spouses and children of pass holders

6. Residence Permit: For long-term residents

7. Special Pass: For specific circumstances not covered by other categories

Each pass type has different requirements, fees, and validity periods. When starting your application, you'll be guided to select the appropriate pass type based on your circumstances.
